pdf_page_count fails when the supplied password does not authenticate the document

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.*

fun main() {
    try {
    val result = Xberg.pdfPageCount(java.nio.file.Files.readAllBytes(java.nio.file.Paths.get("pdf/password_protected.pdf")), "xberg-test-fake-wrong-password-1879")
    } catch (error: Exception) {
        System.err.println("${error::class.simpleName}: ${error.message}")
    }
}
```
